items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: His alto and tenor saxophone sounds are heard on classic jazz recordings with Warren Vache

ctx.x: Red Holloway can be found in diverse musical settings around the world. His alto and tenor saxophone sounds are heard on classic jazz recordings with Warren Vache and traditional blues with John Mayall. Red has performed frequently with Joe Williams and organist Jack McDuff. Currently Red makes his home on the West Coast. He is often seen at jazz festivals and parties across the country where he is appreciated for his sense of humor as well as his outstanding musical skills.
Red was interviewed in Scottsdale, Arizona on March 4, 1995 by Monk Rowe and Dr. Michael Woods.
